NO DAMAGES FOR TERMINATION. NEITHER PARTY WILL BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER FOR DAMAGES OF ANY KIND, INCLUDING WITHOUT LIMITATION INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES, DAMAGES FOR THE LOSS OF GOODWILL, PROSPECTIVE PROFITS OR ANTICIPATED INCOME, OR DAMAGES RESULTING FROM ANY EXPENDITURES, INVESTMENTS, LEASES OR COMMITMENTS MADE BY EITHER PARTY ON ACCOUNT OF THE TERMINATION OR EXPIRATION OF THIS AGREEMENT IN ACCORDANCE WITH ITS TERMS.</quote>
<parameter name="rationale">The Agreement imposes no liquidated damages, stipulated penalty, minimum-volume shortfall charge or early-termination fee on us, so it sits at the preferred position (no LDs payable by Customer). The fee provisions (Art. V, p0050-p0070) are purely usage-based on actual Monthly Notional Volume traded, with no minimum commitment or make-whole amount; Art. IV (p0049) only preserves the Licensor's right to "receive payments for all trades performed using the Licensed Technology" on termination, i.e. accrued fees rather than stipulated damages. Art. XXIII (p0142) affirmatively bars termination damages for both parties. Two non-LD points are noted but not flagged: the audit-cost shift to us on a greater-than-5% discrepancy (p0064) is a cost-reimbursement mechanic, and the 33% Supplemental Payments (p0078) are revenue-share consideration; neither is a penalty triggered by breach or early exit.
